thought.title: CS_CHUNK=256 + Exp-based SiLU + reduced vector ops
thought.description: Increased chunk size from 64 to 256 (4x fewer loop iterations), replaced tanh-based sigmoid (Muls*0.5+Tanh+Adds*1.0+Muls*0.5) with Exp-based SiLU (Muls*-1.0+Exp+Adds*1.0+Div), reducing vector ops from 9 to 8 per chunk iteration. Combined with 4x fewer iterations, total vector instruction count reduced significantly.
thought.reason: For memory-bound element-wise operators, larger chunk sizes improve vector unit utilization by reducing loop overhead and enabling more work per iteration. Exp-based SiLU uses fewer vector operations than the tanh-based approximation. The Div operation replaces Muls(x,0.5)+Tanh+Adds+Mul in the sigmoid path.
thought.target_bottleneck: vector instruction count in element-wise compute loop
